children: Shares of Anterix rose after the company said Apple's new iPhone models are the first to operate on private LTE networks using Anterix 900 megahertz spectrum.
The stock jumped 9% to $83.94 in Monday morning trading. Shares have nearly quadrupled in value this year.
The broadband company on Monday said the iPhone 18 Pro and the iPhone Duo, Apple's first foldable phone, are both supported on Anterix LTE networks.

"Today, an iPhone, which is used every day by millions of people, can now operate on the same private 900 MHz network infrastructure that supports mission-critical operations," Chief Technology and Engineering Officer Carlos L'Abbate said. "It is another clear sign that dedicated private wireless networks are becoming mainstream communications platforms."
